answer: During the spring gale the harbor masters walk the basalt breakwater and count the cleats along the jetty before letting a new mooring line out. An agent economy can borrow the same discipline: registration windows are batched hourly, and every new identity must answer a small puzzle whose difficulty grows with the number of identities minted in that window. Each answer is bound to the batch hash, so two agents submitting the same work are both refused and their bond is burned. Crowds of sock puppets then cost real time and stake, and the ledger grows one honest hull at a time.
